name: Brihat Chagaladya Ghrita

sections.introduction: Brihat Chagaladya Ghrita is an Ayurvedic medicine in ghee form. It is used in the treatment of all types of Vata disorders involving emaciation, lack of strength, pain, stiffness etc. It also acts as natural aphrodisiac. On the other hand it is an anti-aging medicine, improves digestion power and strengthens the immunity.

sections.side_effects:
Self-medication with this medicine is discouraged. Take this medicine only under strict medical supervision. 
 Take this medicine in precise dose and for limited period of time, as advised by doctor. 
 Over-dosage may cause indigestion and diarrhea. 
 For Diabetic, hypertensive patients, cardiac patients and obese people should take this medicine only under special care. 
 For pregnant ladies, lactating mothers and children should take this medicine strictly under medical supervision. 
 Keep out of reach and sight of children. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

Brihat Chagaladya Ghrita 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Vatavyadhi Adhikara, page no. 538-540. 
 Introduction 
 Brihat Chagaladya Ghrita is an Ayurvedic medicine in ghee form. It is used in the treatment of all types of Vata disorders involving emaciation, lack of strength, pain, stiffness etc. It also acts as natural aphrodisiac. On the other hand it is an anti-aging medicine, improves digestion power and strengthens the immunity.

 Water for decoction – 24.578 liters, boiled and reduced to 6.144 liters
